intro: Past exam questions that the study material has no chapter for: short sums on work, interest and speed, and picking the odd word out. There are no book questions here, only real exam questions.

tips.title: Work, interest and speed
tips.body: Work together: add the part of the work each one does in a day (1/6 + 1/12 = 1/4, so 4 days). Simple interest: an amount doubles when the interest reaches 100%. Speed: change every speed to the same unit before comparing (1 m/second = 3.6 km/hr).

tips.title: Odd word out: ask what each one is for
tips.body: Think of where each thing is used or what it does. A bus, a car and a van go on roads; a boat goes on water.
